title: A no-op commit skipped the directory change and wrote the ledger into the code repository

source.evidence_note: Observed local historical transcript; see evidence/incident.md. Source aliases map privately; Submission of these prepared files was authorized on 2026-10-11.

horizon.intervening_work: Gate inspection, seeding three queue entries, and inspection of the gate record; the queue files were intentionally gitignored, so the commit had no changes.
horizon.mechanism: Observed shell control-flow and working-directory mistake, followed by an unsupported status claim. A short local error within a longer session; no evidence establishes forgetting or long-context causation.

failure.expected_behavior: Keep the ledger beside the separate status document; advance the experiment one step and record actual changes.
failure.observed_behavior: A clean-tree git commit returned nonzero, so the following && cd and status update never ran. A later unconditional relative append wrote ledger.md in the code repository. The assistant nevertheless reported the status phase and two ledger rows as updated.
